🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk-off grips crypto: a hot PPI print and surging bond yields knocked Bitcoin below $77K as traders brace for CPI and next week's Fed decision. Yet the institutional plumbing keeps expanding — from SGX and Kalshi perps to MoneyGram's stablecoin card. 📉 Bitcoin Sinks Below $77K as Hot PPI Revives Fed Rate-Hike Fears A hotter-than-expected 5.4% August PPI reading and Brent crude above $107 drove US bond yields to fresh multi-decade highs, dragging Bitcoin under $77,000 and triggering roughly $456M in mostly-long liquidations. Crypto equities fared worse, with Coinbase off about 5% and Strategy down around 7%, as attention turned to Friday's CPI and the September 15–16 Fed meeting. Read full story → ⚖️ Kalshi Plans 24/7 Tesla, Apple and Nvidia Perpetual Futures Prediction-market operator Kalshi intends to seek approval for about 60 perpetual futures tied to major stocks and ETFs — which would be the first regulated single-stock perps in the US. The plan set off a jurisdictional fight after Citadel Securities told the SEC and CFTC that moving equity-linked perps outside SEC oversight could create a parallel shadow market with weaker safeguards against insider trading. More details → 🏛️ SGX Opens Bitcoin and Ether Perps to US Institutions Singapore Exchange secured CFTC authorization under Regulation 48.10 to let US institutional investors trade its Bitcoin and Ether perpetual futures directly, bridging American trading desks with Asian liquidity pools. The contracts have logged about $5.8 billion in cumulative volume since launching in late November 2025, with dated futures and options next in the pipeline. Read more → 🐶 Bitwise to Liquidate Its Dogecoin ETF After Less Than a Year Bitwise is winding down its spot Dogecoin ETF (BWOW), with a final NYSE trading day expected October 14 and cash distributions to remaining holders on October 22 — roughly 10 months after launch. The fund held only around $722,000 in assets and fell about 45% since inception, a blunt reminder that ETF access does not guarantee investor demand. See details → 💳 MoneyGram Launches Stablecoin-Backed Visa Card on Stellar MoneyGram rolled out its first stablecoin-backed Visa card, live first in Colombia, letting customers hold a dollar balance in USDC and spend it anywhere Visa is accepted via Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
